maya: Hi team — quick question. My calendar shows the product tour at 16:00 UTC and also a duplicate at 16:30. I'm in MST. Which one is correct and where do recordings get posted?

jon: Welcome @maya! Official time is 16:00 UTC. The 16:30 invite is a leftover draft from a reschedule. Delete the duplicate. Recordings go to Google Drive -> New Hires / Session Recordings after we redact any customer PII.

maya: Thanks. Outlook stripped the Zoom passcode from the body so I can't join on mobile — any workaround?

rachel: We put the passcode in the event "Location" and in the pinned thread to avoid Outlook/mobile trimming. If you still can't see it, reply here and ops-bot will echo the passcode.

ops-bot: Zoom meeting scheduled: ID 444-555-666, passcode: 7319 (auto-posted)

jon: FYI, slide 6 has vendor info that needs redaction. @rachel will clip that before we move the recording to the shared folder.

rachel: I'll handle redaction and then move the cleaned file to Drive and update ACLs. Will drop the link here after.

maya: One last thing — where do session notes live? I couldn't find the doc linked on the invite.

jon: Session notes are in the event under "Agenda & Notes" (Google Doc). If it's missing, the draft invite didn't include it — DM me and I'll attach.

maya: Great, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
